// NO-LOOKAHEAD REGIME TAG DIAGNOSTIC
// Regime variables are read from the PRIOR CLOSED H1 bar only.
// Macro Bull tag = H1 close > EMA200 AND EMA50 > EMA200 AND EMA200 slope over prior 120 H1 bars > 0.
// Strong Bull tag = Macro Bull plus EMA200 120H slope >= 1.0 current H1 ATR.
// ATR Expansion tag = H1 ATR14 > 1.15 x rolling median ATR14 of prior 240 H1 bars.
// Full OOS Macro Bull trades: N 1,551 | WR 41.39% | End $27,114.38 | Net +$17,114.38 | MaxDD 37.44% | Positive years 11/15.
// Full OOS non-Macro-Bull trades: N 834 | WR 39.21% | End $9,557.54 | Net -$442.46 | MaxDD 31.78%.
// 2012-2021 Macro Bull only: N 669 | WR 52.47% | End $16,436.67 | Net +$6,436.67 | MaxDD 25.33%.
// 2012-2021 non-Macro-Bull: N 400 | WR 46.00% | End $8,251.70 | Net -$1,748.30 | MaxDD 28.48%.
// DECISION: the structural edge is concentrated inside bullish HTF slope regimes. Outside Macro Bull, the edge is absent/negative. Treat BSL Continue BUY + HTF as REGIME-CONDITIONAL, not a generic entry method.
//
// 2) DRAWDOWN REDUCTION
// Adaptive sizing trial: after 2 consecutive losses, reduce risk from 1.00% to 0.50% until next winning trade.
// Result: End $19,290.05 | Net +$9,290.05 | MaxDD 38.85%.
// Trade-off vs baseline: profit falls 41.6%, but MaxDD improves only 1.10 percentage points (39.95% -> 38.85%). REJECT adaptive sizing rule as ineffective DD control for this setup.
//
// Fixed no-lookahead volatility filter trial: keep the original BSL+HTF definition, but accept an entry only when prior-closed H1 ATR14 > 1.15 x prior-240-H1 ATR median.
// Result: N 716 | WR 43.02% | End $14,934.91 | Net +$4,934.91 | MaxDD 17.15% | Positive years 10/15 | MedSL 5.69 | MedTP 8.41.
// Trade-off vs baseline: MaxDD falls 22.80 percentage points (~57% relative reduction), while net profit falls from +$15,914.67 to +$4,934.91 (~69% reduction). This filter meaningfully improves risk quality but materially lowers growth.
// Strong-Bull + ATR-Expansion diagnostic subset: N 480 | WR 43.54% | End $16,100.14 | Net +$6,100.14 | MaxDD 18.25% | Positive years 11/15 | MedSL 5.23 | MedTP 8.21.
// 2012-2021 Strong-Bull + ATR-Expansion only: N 217 | WR 54.84% | End $12,778.45 | Net +$2,778.45 | MaxDD 8.68%.
// This confirms the lower-DD profile also existed before 2022-2026; it is not solely a recent-regime artifact.

// 3) BSL / SSL ASYMMETRY
// Previous standalone SSL Continue SELL checkpoint: N 812 | WR 61.33% | End $11,690.83 | Net +$1,690.83 | MaxDD 22.65% | Positive years 9/15.
// Symmetric follow-up SSL Continue SELL + HTF Structure, using the same rolling train-selection grid as BSL+HTF:
// N 1,341 | WR/TP 38.78% | End $4,258.95 | Net -$5,741.05 | MaxDD 63.11% | Positive OOS years 1/15 | MedSL 2.30 | MedTP 3.50.
// Several folds had no profitable train configuration and therefore no OOS trade under the existing train-score gate.
// DECISION: adding the same HTF Structure filter materially DESTROYS the SELL-side edge. SSL does not benefit from the filter that rescues BSL.
// Explicit asymmetry finding: BUY continuation requires bullish HTF/regime context to become viable; SELL continuation was already positive standalone and becomes materially worse with the symmetric HTF filter. Do NOT force symmetric BSL/SSL continuation logic.
